tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Current season riders' championship: position, points, wins and podiums for every rider, plus the teams' totals.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Every round of the current season with dates, circuit and country, marked as finished, this weekend or upcoming.

tools.name: get_next_race
tools.description: The next (or current) Grand Prix weekend with its full session schedule in UTC: practice, qualifying, sprint and race.

tools.name: get_race_results
tools.description: Results of a finished session. Defaults to the main race of the most recent finished Grand Prix. Pick another weekend by round number or by name/country (e.g. "Mugello", "Italy", "Indonesia").

tools.name: get_rider
tools.description: A rider's profile: team, bike, nationality, age, short bio and current championship position.

tools.name: get_live_timing
tools.description: Live timing for the session on track right now (positions, gaps, laps). Says when nothing is running.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Latest MotoGP headlines with source and link.
